{
  "to": ["Gabriel Fontes", "Sylvia Nakamura"],
  "cc": [],
  "subject": "Tip reporting for the quarter — quick check",
  "body": "Hi Gabriel, Sylvia,

Hope you’re both doing well. I was going over the numbers for the quarter, and the tip reporting looks off to me — seems like it’s lower than what we’ve seen in past quarters, even with the same traffic. I might be missing something, but I want to make sure we’re capturing everything correctly before we file.

Can you both take a look and let me know if there’s anything we need to adjust or if there’s a reason for the dip? I’d like to get this squared away before the end of the week so we’re not caught off guard.

Thanks — appreciate the quick response.

Marco",
  "summary": "Marco notices the quarterly tip reporting appears low and asks Gabriel and Sylvia to review and explain any discrepancies before the filing deadline."
}
